spans.text: Wow! You got so many. Awesome.
As expected of M4A1's trusted commander. Hats off to you...
As you've probably learned, I'm M4A1's boss.
Still, you actually found her. That's really...brilliant of you.
I won't say any more for now. It's not the right time, and it's not important at the moment.
M4 is safe. That's all that matters.
Let's leave it at that. Thanks again, Commander.
